steps.instruction: Mix 1 tablespoon each of cayenne pepper, salt and black pepper.
Toss 24 chicken wingettes with the spice mix.
Put the wingettes in the refrigerator.
In a microwave-safe bowl, mix 1 cup of tomato paste and 1/4 cup of molasses.
Add 3 drops of liquid smoke, 2 tablespoons cider vinegar and 2 tablespoons white wine.
Microwave the sauce until it is warm and well mixed.
Brush the wings on all sides with about 3/4 of the sauce.
steps.spoken: Brush the wings on all sides with about three quarters of the sauce. Or put three quarters of the sauce in a zip-top bag with the wings.

steps.instruction: Refrigerate the wings for as long as you can.
Grill the wings until a thermometer reads 165 °F.
Move the wings to a plate and cover them.
Let the wings rest for 5 minutes, then serve with the rest of the sauce.
